dimensions.assessment: Affects state environmental agencies, industrial sources, and populations in nonattainment areas across multiple EPA regions.
dimensions.evidence: no sanction or fee under section 179 or 185 shall apply with respect to a State (or an area or source therein)

dimensions.assessment: Alters regulatory burdens, review timelines, and potential financial penalties for states regarding air quality standards.
dimensions.evidence: If the State demonstrates that the State would have avoided such deficiency... no sanction or fee under section 179 or 185 shall apply

dimensions.assessment: May reduce potential penalty fees for states and alter compliance costs, though specific fiscal amounts are not stated.
Broadly amends multiple sections of the Clean Air Act concerning air quality standards review, state plans, wildfire mitigation, and advisory committee duties.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Clean Air Act to facilitate State implementation of national ambient air quality standards, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Imposes permanent statutory changes to the Clean Air Act governing standard reviews, state plans, and exceptional event petitions.
dimensions.evidence: Paragraphs (1) and (2)(B) of section 109(d) of the Clean Air Act (42 U.S.C. 7409(d)) are amended by striking 'five-year intervals' each place it appears and inserting '10-year intervals'.

missing_information: Exact economic or cost impact on state agencies and regulated entities
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Clean Air Act to alter timelines for National Ambient Air Quality Standards reviews, add economic attainability considerations, modify state implementation plan procedures, revise exceptional events definitions, and exempt certain nonattainment areas from specific sanctions.
